Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile sha256 0a75419e... is byte-identical to the template environment/Dockerfile (same hash). It is FROM node:22-bookworm-slim, apt installs ca-certificates git procps sqlite3, npm -g installs pinned express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1, sets NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, copies instructions/ and assets/, inits /app git repo; no ENV/ARG secrets, no tokens, no keys. 'Nothing secretly needs an install' (internal annotation): solution/app/package.json depends only on better-sqlite3 12.4.1 and express 5.1.0, matching the globally preinstalled pinned versions; src/db.js:7 and src/index.js:18 require only those plus Node built-ins; solve.sh copies files and runs no npm install. integration.md:3-4 and instruction.md:13 state the packages are available via NODE_PATH and 'don't install packages', so the agent image provides everything the stated contract needs. 2 CPU / 4096 MB is sane for one Node 22 + Express + better-sqlite3 process plus an agent; the image builds no browser. Secret/PII scan of environment/: grep for api key/secret/token/password/sk-/private key hits only hireops_rules.md:11 demo password `Hireops!2026`, which SKILL.md lists as an intentional known false positive; seed emails use reserved fictional domains (@hireops.example, @candidates.example, @mail.example). Network posture public is correct per workbook and skill and is not flagged. Adversarial probes: (a) a broken app that needs an extra npm package would fail at runtime regardless of this row, and public network means the agent could even install it - not an environment defect; (b) a conforming app using only Express/better-sqlite3/built-ins runs in this image unchanged - no conforming alternative is blocked by the resource or network settings. Runtime evidence: raw-evidence-index.json records scripted golden runs in the verifier image only; no separate agent-image build log is indexed. This row is a static configuration check and the agent Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template, so no required measurement is missing for this row.
